channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Portaria do TSE sobre planos de conformidade abre metodologias de plataformas
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) is preparing to issue a regulation that implements Article 125-B of the electoral propaganda resolution, requiring digital platforms with over 5 million monthly active users in Brazil to develop compliance plans to prevent and mitigate risks to electoral integrity. The plans must detail preventive measures across ten duty categories, with public summaries and restricted TSE access to implementation evidence, shifting from a reactive to a preventive governance and transparency model.

item.title: Deputado do PT é multado em R$ 10 mil por vídeo de Tarcísio como boneco Chucky
item.description: State deputy Emídio de Souza (PT) was fined R$10,000 for publishing an AI-generated video on social media depicting Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) as the Chucky doll from the 'Child's Play' franchise. The penalty was imposed for improper use of image and dissemination of offensive content via artificial intelligence. The case highlights growing concerns over deepfakes and digital ethics in electoral campaigns.

item.title: PT de Goiás mantém pré-candidatura de Luis Cesar Bueno ao governo
item.description: The Goiás state directory of the Workers' Party (PT) decided to maintain the pre-candidacy of Luis Cesar Bueno for governor, defying President Lula's preference for federal deputy Adriana Accorsi. The party's convention to officially nominate candidates has been set for August 4 ahead of the October elections. According to a Real Time Big Data poll from July 9, Luis Cesar Bueno polls at only 5%, placing him fourth in the electoral race.

item.title: Decisão de Moraes abre margem para Michelle Bolsonaro comandar jogo político no PL
item.description: The decision by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes to ban visits from Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to former President Jair Bolsonaro opens space for Michelle Bolsonaro to play a more prominent role in the political maneuvering within the Liberal Party (PL). Although she has indicated she does not seek to engage in further internal conflicts, her influence in the party’s succession dynamics is expected to grow as other Bolsonaro family members are sidelined from active politics.

item.title: Nem a dentadura de Trump é igual à do SUS, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula joked that the SUS provides dentures made via 3D scanning and printing — something even Trump’s dentures don’t match. He made the comment during a meeting with Anfavea at the Palácio do Planalto, highlighting the purchase of 880 mobile dental vans. Lula also noted he has publicly criticized Trump 63 times over 3.5 years, while Trump has mentioned him only 11 times in 1.5 years.

item.title: Carlos Portinho será candidato ao Senado pelo Rio em vaga deixada por Cláudio Castro
item.description: Fluminense PL leadership confirmed that Senator Carlos Portinho will be the party's Senate candidate for Rio de Janeiro, replacing former Governor Cláudio Castro, who withdrew after being linked to investigations involving banker Daniel Vorcaro. The official announcement is expected from Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in the coming hours. Portinho defeated Deputy Carlos Jordy in the internal selection, benefiting from his incumbent senatorial mandate and support from numerous interior mayors.

item.title: Tábata busca Planalto para votar PL da Misoginia antes do recesso
item.description: Federal Deputy Tabata Amaral (PSB-SP), rapporteur of the bill criminalizing misogyny, met with Planalto officials to secure a vote before the parliamentary recess, despite resistance from Christian and right-wing blocs. The bill, which already had urgency approved, prescribes 2 to 5 years in prison and fines, with increased penalties for offenders with large digital audiences or economic motives. Tabata argues the bill targets harmful online conduct, not innocuous comments, and says House Speaker Hugo Motta committed to scheduling the vote.

item.title: PL escala Carlos Portinho para disputa ao Senado no Rio
item.description: The PL has designated Senator Carlos Portinho as its Senate candidate for Rio de Janeiro, following the withdrawal of Cláudio Castro amid Federal Police investigations. The decision was made by Flávio Bolsonaro and Jair Bolsonaro. Portinho, who assumed office as a substitute in 2020, is seen as a consensus figure untainted by scandal, with appeal beyond the core bolsonarist base.

item.title: Vai à CCJ projeto que dificulta liberdade provisória para presos em flagrante
item.description: The Senate approved a bill that restricts provisional liberty for individuals arrested in flagrante in serious cases such as recidivism, militia participation, illegal possession of restricted firearms, heinous crimes, and others, requiring judges to justify any release. Originally proposed by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, the bill was expanded by rapporteur Marcio Bittar to include more offenses while still allowing judges to grant provisional liberty with clear reasoning. The bill now proceeds to the Senate's Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ).

item.title: Crusoé: Lula autoriza educação política na escola: ideologização?
item.description: President Lula signed a bill making political education and citizenship rights a mandatory component of basic education, integrated into the study of social and political reality. The measure aims to foster critical and engaged citizenship, though it has sparked debate over potential ideological indoctrination in schools.

item.title: Correia diz que Flávio usou visita a Bolsonaro como “gabinete político”
item.description: Federal Deputy Rogério Correia (PT-MG) criticized the 90-day ban imposed by Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes on Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) from visiting former President Jair Bolsonaro, claiming the visits were being used as a 'political cabinet'. Correia argued the measure prevents Flávio from leveraging his proximity to the ex-president for political articulation and institutional influence.

item.title: Janones: ‘A meta não é mais eleger Lula, mas dizimar, exterminar o bolsonarismo’
item.description: Federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) stated that the goal for 2026 should no longer be merely re-electing Lula, but the 'complete extermination of bolsonarism'. He argues that only a landslide Lula victory in October can definitively end bolsonarism's influence, warning that a narrow win would leave the movement alive for at least four more years. Janones declared he is ready to 'kill or die' for the cause, amid Lula's lead in polls and Flávio Bolsonaro's struggles to regain electoral support.

item.title: Deputadas cobram aprovação de projeto que criminaliza misoginia antes do recesso na Câmara
item.description: The female caucus in Brazil's Chamber of Deputies urged the urgent approval of a bill equating misogyny with racism before the parliamentary recess began on Saturday. Although Chamber President Hugo Motta had committed to voting on the proposal, the vote was postponed due to opposition from religious deputies who fear misinterpretation and the criminalization of biblical texts. Female lawmakers stressed the bill does not target religion or free expression but seeks to criminalize violence against women in any setting.

item.title: Renan Santos compara Janja à Maria Antonieta
item.description: Renan Santos, a pre-candidate for presidency from the Missão party, criticized First Lady Rosângela da Silva (Janja) for her remarks on international travel expenses, comparing her attitude to that of Marie Antoinette. He accused her of being out of touch with ordinary Brazilians and pledged to increase transparency in presidential spending. The video was posted on his social media and sparked widespread discussion.

item.title: Empresas de pesquisa criticam proposta do TSE de criar ‘selo de qualidade’ para levantamentos
item.description: TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques' proposal to create an 'Electoral Accuracy Seal' awarding polling institutes whose surveys closest match official election results has drawn criticism from major research firms. They argue the initiative mistakenly treats voter intention polls as predictions, ignoring that opinions can shift between interviews and voting. The proposal followed the suspension of an AtlasIntel poll showing a six-point drop for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, which firms labeled censorship, and was seen as counterproductive due to perceived lack of understanding of polling methodology by the minister.

item.title: Dino chama terceirização de emendas de ‘esdrúxula’ e critica cota a ex-parlamentares
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino stated that only sitting congressmembers can propose and deliberate on parliamentary amendments, declaring 'outsourcing' of amendments illegal. He criticized informal budgetary centers and the transfer of budget control to non-parliamentarians, calling it a constitutional vice, and ordered asset freezes totaling R$125 million against Valdemar Costa Neto and Eduardo Cunha for allegedly indicating amendments without authority.

item.title: TSE e empresas de pesquisa fortalecem diálogo institucional sobre metodologias eleitorais
item.description: TSE President Justice Kassio Nunes Marques met with representatives from 16 electoral research institutes to strengthen institutional dialogue and discuss methodologies for opinion polls ahead of the 2026 General Elections. The meeting aimed to enhance transparency, legal security, and public trust, without addressing specific results or interfering in the technical autonomy of the firms.

item.title: OAB pede a Moraes que assegure comunicação entre Flávio e Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: The Brazilian Bar Association (OAB) asked Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes to ensure communication between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and former President Jair Bolsonaro, after Moraes barred Flávio from visiting Jair for 90 days while he serves house arrest. The OAB argued that Flávio acts as Jair’s lawyer and that the restriction violates professional prerogatives of defense, without challenging the decision’s merits. Moraes blocked the visits after Flávio read a letter from Jair designating him as a 'spokesperson', which the minister deemed a violation of the cautelar measure prohibiting third-party social media use and potential premature electoral propaganda.

item.title: Crusoé: Associação contesta ‘selo de acurácia eleitoral’ proposto por Nunes Marques
item.description: The Brazilian Association of Market Research Institutes (ABIPM) challenged the proposal by TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques to create an 'electoral accuracy seal' to recognize the most precise polling institutes in elections. The association argues the measure could create perverse incentives, undermining the independence and credibility of polls. The project was presented in a meeting with 16 research institutes at the TSE headquarters.

item.title: OAB pede que Moraes reconsidere veto às visitas de Flávio a Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: The Brazilian Bar Association (OAB) urged Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes to reconsider the ban on visits from Flávio Bolsonaro to former President Jair Bolsonaro, stating that Flávio acts as his constituted lawyer and that the restriction violates the right to confidential communication and professional activity. Moraes’ 90-day visitation ban, issued after Jair Bolsonaro’s letter was shared on Flávio’s social media, was labeled illegal and unconstitutional by the senator’s defense. Flávio is the PL’s pre-candidate for president in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Bolsonaro não quer Michelle no Executivo antes de ter experiência de mandato, diz Valdemar
item.description: PL president Valdemar Costa Neto stated that former president Jair Bolsonaro does not want Michelle Bolsonaro to run for an executive office before gaining experience in a public position. The comment comes amid internal party divisions over the viability of Flávio Bolsonaro as a presidential candidate in 2026.

item.title: OAB pede a Moraes para liberar 'comunicação pessoal e reservada' entre Flávio e Jair Bolsonaro após suspensão de visitas
item.description: The Brazilian Bar Association (OAB) asked Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes to ensure personal and reserved communication between Flávio Bolsonaro and Jair Bolsonaro, arguing that the senator acts as his father's lawyer. The request follows Moraes' 90-day suspension of visits after the ex-president's letter was shared on social media, which may constitute premature election campaigning. Flávio Bolsonaro is a pre-candidate for president in 2026.

item.title: Decisão de Moraes de suspender visitas de Flávio a Bolsonaro bomba nas redes
item.description: The decision by Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes to suspend Flávio Bolsonaro's visits to former President Jair Bolsonaro for 90 days sparked over 2 million social media interactions in the last 24 hours. Bolsonarist groups denounced the move as a violation of family rights, drawing parallels to Lula's 2018 imprisonment, while Lula supporters celebrated it with irony, framing it as a justified punishment for attempting to circumvent judicial orders through familial ties. 'Moraes' topped X's Trending Topics in Brazil, alongside 'Xandão', 'Flávio', and 'Jair'.

item.title: O cálculo da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro para não comprar briga pública com Damares
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign chose not to publicly respond to Damares Alves' complaints about attacks from the right and his allies, aiming to de-escalate tensions and avoid a direct confrontation. The strategy is to cool the internal dispute while maintaining focus on party unity despite disagreements.

item.title: Caiado apoia Damares e diz que Lula e Bolsonaro são “farinha do mesmo saco”
item.description: PSD presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado claimed that Lula and Bolsonaro are 'cut from the same cloth' for fueling political polarization, then defended Senator Damares Alves (Republicanos-DF) in a post on social media X. He positioned himself as an alternative to the Lula-Bolsonaro bipolarity, seeking to attract conservative support without aligning directly with either pole.

item.title: OAB pede a Moraes que garanta comunicação entre Flávio e Bolsonaro na condição de advogado
item.description: The Brazilian Bar Association (OAB) asked Minister Alexandre de Moraes to ensure communication between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and former President Jair Bolsonaro for legal defense purposes, arguing that the visitation suspension should not impede the exercise of advocacy. The OAB stated it does not challenge the merits of the decision but defends the professional prerogatives of lawyers, citing the Statute of the Legal Profession. Flávio Bolsonaro claims he acts as his father’s lawyer and that the restriction interferes with his professional rights and the 2026 elections.

item.title: Institutos de pesquisa dizem que selo do TSE "confunde ciência com bola de cristal"
item.description: The Abep criticized the TSE's proposal to create the Electoral Accuracy Seal, arguing that equating voter intention polls with electoral predictions is akin to relying on a 'crystal ball'. The association warned that the seal would incentivize manipulating results to win the award rather than improving methodological rigor, ultimately undermining the quality of electoral information.

item.title: “Ninguém pode aceitar um filho não visitar um pai”, diz Valdemar
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL, criticized the decision by Minister Alexandre de Moraes of the STF to prohibit Senator Flávio Bolsonaro from visiting former President Jair Bolsonaro for 90 days, stating that 'no one can accept a son not visiting his father'. Despite the criticism, Valdemar believed the measure could help the senator gain ground in presidential polls.

item.title: Flávio agradece OAB por ofício pedindo liberação de visita a Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro thanked the Brazilian Bar Association (OAB) for sending a letter to Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes requesting permission to visit his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, on the grounds that he acts as his constituted lawyer. The OAB argued that personal visit restrictions cannot absolutely block professional contact necessary for legal representation, even if the senator is a relative of the detained individual. Justice Moraes had banned the visits for 90 days after a letter from Bolsonaro was disclosed, which he considered potentially constituting premature electoral propaganda.

item.title: Flávio agradece à OAB por ofício a Moraes sobre comunicação com Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro thanked the Brazilian Bar Association (OAB) for a letter sent to Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes, requesting that personal and confidential communication between lawyer and client be ensured in the case of former President Jair Bolsonaro. The OAB's letter aims to protect professional confidentiality in the former president's conversations with his legal team. Flávio Bolsonaro, a pre-candidate for president in 2026, voiced his support for the OAB's initiative.

item.title: Pesquisa mostra o papel de Nikolas Ferreira no levante das redes contra Moraes e o STF
item.description: Ativaweb DataLab identified Nikolas Ferreira as the main digital amplifier of Bolsonarist criticisms against Minister Alexandre de Moraes and the STF, generating engagement four times higher than Flávio Bolsonaro on the same issue. Over 18 hours of monitoring, the movement against the ban on Flávio visiting his father reached over 18 million social media posts, with Ferreira leading due to his 22 million followers and high engagement. The study emphasizes that in contemporary political communication, digital mobilization capacity can be as decisive as the event itself in amplifying and accelerating narrative circulation.

item.title: Cid Gomes atende pedido de Lula e vai concorrer ao Senado pelo Ceará
item.description: Senator Cid Gomes (PSB) will run for re-election to the Senate in Ceará after acceding to a request from President Lula (PT). The announcement was made by Governor Elmano de Freitas (PT) following a meeting with Lula in Brasília, strengthening the state’s governing ticket. Cid Gomes bolsters Elmano’s re-election bid against his main rival, Ciro Gomes (PSDB), his brother and former governor.

item.title: O argumento da OAB para tentar liberar visitas de Flávio a Bolsonaro
item.description: The OAB requested that Justice Alexandre de Moraes of the STF reconsider the decision suspending visits from Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to former President Jair Bolsonaro, arguing that Flávio, as a licensed attorney representing his father, holds professional privileges that cannot be absolutely restricted. The organization maintains that communication between them must be allowed for strictly professional purposes, even under conditions deemed appropriate by the minister.

item.title: OAB intercede pelo advogado Flávio Bolsonaro no STF
item.description: The Federal Council of the Brazilian Bar Association (OAB) filed a motion with Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes requesting the protection of confidential attorney-client communications in the case of former President Jair Bolsonaro. The move is seen as indirect support for Flávio Bolsonaro, the former president’s son and lawyer, who is representing him in legal proceedings.

item.title: A reação de empresas ao plano do TSE de criar um selo de precisão para pesquisas eleitorais
item.description: The Brazilian Association of Research Companies (ABEP) criticized the TSE's proposal to create an accuracy seal for electoral polls, arguing that requiring polls to 'hit' the result confuses science with crystal ball gazing, as voter intentions can change between the interview and election day. The association states that poll quality should be judged by methodology, transparency, and field execution, not by future outcomes, and warns the proposal could create perverse incentives for less rigorous institutes to manipulate numbers to follow the consensus.

item.title: A força da mobilização bolsonarista contra Moraes e o STF, após decisão sobre Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes' decision to suspend Flávio Bolsonaro's visits to his father for 90 days during the electoral campaign triggered over 18 million social media posts in 18 hours, with 84.7% of analyzed expressions criticizing the STF and the minister. The episode demonstrates how judicial rulings rapidly become fuel for digital political narratives, driven by Bolsonarist mobilization ahead of the 2026 party conventions.

item.title: Furto de câmeras de vigilância deve ter pena maior, aprova CSP
item.description: The Public Security Commission approved PL 3.033/2025, which increases penalties for theft, robbery, and receiving of surveillance cameras and electronic monitoring equipment used in public or private security. The bill, sponsored by Senator Marcelo Castro (MDB-PI), received a favorable opinion from Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) and will now be analyzed by the Constitution and Justice Commission. The proposal sets prison sentences of 2 to 8 years for qualified theft and 6 to 12 years for robbery, plus fines, when these crimes involve such equipment in public areas or publicly accessible private spaces.

item.title: O mais votado vence? Entenda como funciona a eleição de deputado no Brasil
item.description: In Brazil's deputy elections, the open-list proportional system allocates seats based on electoral and party quotients, not solely on individual candidate votes. This allows smaller parties to gain representation, reflecting societal diversity. The most-voted candidate does not automatically win a seat, as distribution depends on the party's overall performance.

item.title: FPBio e entidades entregam a Lula carta em defesa da adoção imediata do B17
item.description: The Parliamentary Front for Biodiesel (FPBio) and biodiesel supply chain entities delivered a letter to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva urging the immediate adoption of B17 — a 17% biodiesel blend in fossil diesel — to strengthen the sector, reduce emissions, and ensure energy security. The letter was handed over on Monday, the 13th, in São Paulo, as part of broader efforts to push the federal government to accelerate the energy transition in transportation.

item.title: OAB defende no STF direito de Flávio visitar Bolsonaro
item.description: The Federal Council of the Brazilian Bar Association (OAB) filed a petition with the STF requesting the guarantee of confidential communication between lawyer and client, defending Flávio Bolsonaro’s right to visit former President Jair Bolsonaro after Justice Alexandre de Moraes barred such visits for 90 days. The OAB emphasized its technical and non-partisan role, stating that no lawyer can be prevented from defending a client regardless of familial ties or political affiliation. The request followed Flávio’s formal registration as his father’s lawyer in March to enable in-person meetings.

item.title: OAB pede que Moraes autorize Flávio a visitar Bolsonaro como advogado
item.description: The Brazilian Bar Association (OAB) requested that Minister Alexandre de Moraes allow Flávio Bolsonaro to visit his father, Jair Bolsonaro, as his lawyer, arguing that the 90-day ban on personal visits should not obstruct professional contact necessary for his defense. The OAB stressed its institutional role in defending lawyers' prerogatives, without interfering in the merits of the criminal case or the court's measures.

item.title: Selo do TSE para pesquisa eleitoral gera divergência entre institutos
item.description: The TSE proposed an 'Electoral Accuracy Seal' to reward polling institutes whose estimates closely match official results, but the initiative sparked division: Abep-affiliated institutes opposed it, while others like AtlasIntel supported it, stressing the need to define clear parameters. The court will accept suggestions until Friday (July 17) and emphasized that changes to electoral rules require careful analysis and will only be implemented when absolutely necessary.

item.title: Pesquisas eleitorais: Institutos dizem que proposta de Nunes Marques 'confunde ciência com bola de cristal'
item.description: The ABEP criticized the TSE's proposal to create a seal for polling institutes whose surveys come closest to official election results, stating it confuses science with crystal ball gazing. The association argued that polls measure voter intent at the time of data collection and do not predict future outcomes, as voter opinions can change. It also warned the seal could create a 'perverse incentive,' encouraging less rigorous institutes to manipulate numbers to match consensus, undermining information quality.

item.title: Caiado sobre Flávio Bolsonaro: 'Liderança você não herda, liderança você cria'
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, pré-presidential candidate from the PSD, criticized Flávio Bolsonaro for relying on his father Jair Bolsonaro’s support in his campaign, stating that 'leadership is not inherited, it is created'. He argued that a presidential candidate must demonstrate independent capacity to handle crises without familial backing, and said this debate distracts from priority issues like health, education, and national sovereignty. Caiado also accused the Lula government of having 'delivered everything to the Comando Vermelho and the PCC', and criticized both Lula and his opponents for exploiting political conflict instead of discussing substantive policy.

item.title: Trump volta atrás em taxa de 20% sobre carga de navios no Estreito de Ormuz
item.description: President Donald Trump announced he will replace the 20% fee on ship cargo transiting the Strait of Hormuz, announced the previous day, with commercial and investment agreements with Gulf nations. The measure had been criticized by Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, who called it 'piracy'. The reversal follows international pressure and concerns over global trade impacts.

item.title: Quem ficou preso melhor, Lula ou Bolsonaro?
item.description: The suspension of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's visits to his father, Jair Bolsonaro, has sparked comparisons between the imprisonments of Lula and Bolsonaro, with Bolsonaro supporters emphasizing that Lula had greater access to communication while detained in the PF cell in Curitiba. Lula was convicted for corruption and money laundering, while Bolsonaro faces investigation for alleged coup attempt following the 2022 elections. The debate highlights polarization over legal treatment and detention conditions of political leaders.

item.title: Entorno de Michelle aposta em maior protagonismo após decisão de Moraes, enquanto aliados de Flávio defendem nova tentativa de reaproximação
item.description: The decision by Minister Alexandre de Moraes to ban Flávio Bolsonaro from visiting Jair Bolsonaro for 90 days has opened space for Michelle Bolsonaro to gain greater prominence in the presidential campaign, as she maintains direct access to the former president, while Flávio’s allies hope for a future rapprochement. The ruling followed Moraes’ finding that Flávio used visitation rights to obtain a letter intended for social media dissemination, circumventing Bolsonaro’s ban on digital platform use. Michelle, who lives with the former president, is integrated into the PL leadership and faces no judicial restrictions, making her a natural conduit to maintain communication with Bolsonaro during Flávio’s absence.

item.title: Base de Lula aciona TSE e acusa Flávio de propaganda eleitoral antecipada
item.description: The PT-PV-PCdoB federation filed a complaint with the TSE against PL’s pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, alleging illegal early electioneering during a live stream where he asked for votes, displayed his ballot number, presented campaign proposals, and attacked President Lula. The broadcast also featured a letter from Jair Bolsonaro, prompting Minister Alexandre de Moraes to ban Flávio from visiting his imprisoned father until after the first round. The coalition demands the video be removed from YouTube within 24 hours and seeks fines.

item.title: Ex-candidata a vereadora em SP, Zilu Camargo tem contas de campanha rejeitadas e deverá devolver R$ 100 mil ao Tesouro
item.description: São Paulo’s Electoral Justice rejected the campaign accounts of Zilu Camargo, former 2024 city council candidate for União Brasil, ordering her to return R$ 100 thousand to the National Treasury due to an invalid service contract lacking the contractor’s signature. Her campaign received approximately R$ 1.8 million in public funds but failed to timely submit financial reports, including a R$ 550 thousand party donation, and irregularly contracted a political marketing firm for R$ 316.6 thousand after the audit deadline. Despite her appeal, Judge Cecilia Pinheiro da Fonseca upheld the ruling, backed by the Electoral Prosecutor’s Office, which deemed the flaws substantive and damaging to financial traceability.

item.title: Agro insiste em teto maior para renegociação de dívidas rurais
item.description: The Agricultural Parliamentary Front (FPA) and the federal government are negotiating the ceiling for rural debt renegotiation by CPF, with the Ministry of Finance advocating for R$ 8 million and the agribusiness bloc pushing for R$ 10 million. Bill PL 5.122/2023, already approved by the Senate, has an estimated impact of R$ 140 billion over 13 years, according to Senator Jaime Bagattoli (PL-RO), who argues the limit must reflect climate-related losses and commodity volatility. He stated that judicialization of the proposal is not the main concern at this time.
